# GNC telemetry dictionary, version 1

The packets the flight computer downlinks for the GNC console. This dictionary is the single source of truth, in `telemetry/dictionary.json`. This document, the flight software packet code (`flight_sw/include/fsw/TelemetryPackets.hpp`) and the console decoders (`web/js/gnc/gncPackets.generated.js`) are generated from it by `tools/telemetry/generate.py`; edit the dictionary, not the generated files. It is the contract between `flight_sw` (which builds the packets), the comms model, `sim_server` (which forwards them unchanged) and the consoles (which decode them), and the basis of the ground segment's archive and limit checking.

Everything here is something the vehicle knows: flight software state, its estimates, its commands and raw sensor readings. Never truth.

## Packet format

CCSDS Space Packet (CCSDS 133.0-B-2), telemetry, **big-endian** (network byte order).

### Primary header (6 bytes)

| Bits | Field | Value |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | Packet version number | 0 |
| 1 | Packet type | 0 (telemetry) |
| 1 | Secondary header flag | 1 |
| 11 | APID | see the table below |
| 2 | Sequence flags | 0b11 (unsegmented) |
| 14 | Packet sequence count | per APID, starts at 0, wraps 16383 -> 0 |
| 16 | Packet data length | (secondary header + user data length in bytes) - 1 |

### Secondary header (6 bytes): CUC time code

| Bytes | Field |
|---|---|
| 4 | coarse time: whole seconds of flight computer time (u32) |
| 2 | fine time: fraction of a second in units of 1/65536 s (u16) |

Flight computer time is `Hal::timeSec()`, seconds since the flight computer started (the sim start). Onboard time = coarse + fine / 65536.

### User data

Fields follow in the order listed, with no implicit padding (explicit `pad` bytes are zero). Types: `u8`, `u16`, `u32`, `f32` (IEEE 754 single), `f64` (IEEE 754 double), all big-endian. Angles in radians, SI units. Offsets in the tables below are computed by the generator.

Total packet length = 12 + user data length. Every packet is at most 256 bytes.

## APIDs

| APID | Name | Rate | User data length |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0x100 (256) | FSW status | 10 Hz | 20 |
| 0x101 (257) | Mission config | 1 Hz | 36 |
| 0x110 (272) | Navigation | 50 Hz | 80 |
| 0x120 (288) | Guidance and control | 50 Hz | 84 |
| 0x130 (304) | Actuator feedback | 50 Hz | 36 |
| 0x140 (320) | GNSS | each new fix (10 Hz) | 56 |

Rates are of flight computer cycles at 100 Hz: 50 Hz packets go on even cycles, 10 Hz on every 10th cycle, 1 Hz on every 100th, starting with cycle 0. The GNSS packet goes on the first cycle that sees a new receiver solution.

### 0x100 FSW status

Flight software mode, health flags and counters.

| Offset | Type | Field | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | mode | flight software mode (`fsw::HopMode`): 0 Prelaunch, 1 Ignition, 2 Ascent, 4 Descent, 5 FinalDescent, 6 Landed |
| 1 | u8 | flags | status flags: bit 0 engines on (`enginesOn`), bit 1 horizontal nav valid (`navValid`), bit 2 translating to target (`translating`), bit 3 aligned over target (`aligned`), bit 4 GNSS ready (fix count >= required) (`gnssReady`) |
| 2 | u16 | gnssFixCount | GNSS fixes received; saturates at 65535 |
| 4 | u32 | cycleCount | flight computer cycles since start |
| 8 | f32 | timeInMode | [s] time in the current mode |
| 12 | f32 | propellant | [kg] propellant estimate |
| 16 | f32 | mass | [kg] vehicle mass estimate |

### 0x101 Mission config

The target and hop parameters the flight software is configured with.

| Offset | Type | Field | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | f64 | targetLatitude | [rad] WGS-84 geodetic |
| 8 | f64 | targetLongitude | [rad] east positive |
| 16 | f64 | targetHeight | [m] above the WGS-84 ellipsoid |
| 24 | f32 | targetAltitude | [m] hop altitude |
| 28 | f32 | alignTolerance | [m] landing alignment tolerance |
| 32 | f32 | translateAltitude | [m] altitude at which translation to the target starts |

### 0x110 Navigation

Estimates are the flight software's; "measured" values are the latest raw sensor readings.

| Offset | Type | Field | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | f32[4] | attitude | components w, x, y, z; estimated, body to local ENU |
| 16 | f32[3] | angularRate | [rad/s] components x, y, z; measured (IMU), body |
| 28 | f32[3] | specificForce | [m/s^2] components x, y, z; measured (IMU), body |
| 40 | f32 | altitude | [m] estimated, base above ground |
| 44 | f32 | verticalVelocity | [m/s] estimated |
| 48 | f32 | altimeterRange | [m] measured slant range |
| 52 | u8 | altimeterValid | 0 or 1: 0 or 1 |
| 53 | u8[3] | pad | 0 |
| 56 | f32 | east | [m] estimated, IMU point in the target's ENU frame |
| 60 | f32 | north | [m] estimated, IMU point in the target's ENU frame |
| 64 | f32 | velocityEast | [m/s] estimated |
| 68 | f32 | velocityNorth | [m/s] estimated |
| 72 | f32 | accelBiasEast | [m/s^2] estimated apparent acceleration bias |
| 76 | f32 | accelBiasNorth | [m/s^2] estimated apparent acceleration bias |

### 0x120 Guidance and control

Guidance setpoints, control commands and the per-engine commands sent to the actuators.

| Offset | Type | Field | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | f32 | altitudeSetpoint | [m] altitude setpoint |
| 4 | f32 | velocitySetpoint | [m/s] vertical velocity setpoint |
| 8 | f32 | eastSetpoint | [m] horizontal target, target frame |
| 12 | f32 | northSetpoint | [m] horizontal target, target frame |
| 16 | f32 | eastAccelCommand | [m/s^2] commanded east acceleration |
| 20 | f32 | northAccelCommand | [m/s^2] commanded north acceleration |
| 24 | f32[3] | attitudeError | [rad] components x, y, z; body |
| 36 | gnc_engine[3] | engines | per engine command |

Record `gnc_engine` (16 bytes), repeated 3 times, record i at the field offset plus 16 i. Per-engine command in the guidance and control packet.

| Offset | Type | Field | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | on | engine commanded on: 0 or 1 |
| 1 | u8[3] | pad | 0 |
| 4 | f32 | throttle | [fraction] throttle command, fraction of rated flow |
| 8 | f32 | pitch | [rad] gimbal pitch command (about body x) |
| 12 | f32 | yaw | [rad] gimbal yaw command (about body y) |

### 0x130 Actuator feedback

Measured gimbal positions from the gimbal position sensors (`GimbalFeedbackModel`).

| Offset | Type | Field | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | feedback_engine[3] | engines | per engine measured gimbal position |

Record `feedback_engine` (12 bytes), repeated 3 times, record i at the field offset plus 12 i. Per-engine measured gimbal position in the actuator feedback packet.

| Offset | Type | Field | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | valid | gimbal position sensor reading is valid: 0 or 1 |
| 1 | u8[3] | pad | 0 |
| 4 | f32 | pitch | [rad] measured gimbal pitch |
| 8 | f32 | yaw | [rad] measured gimbal yaw |

### 0x140 GNSS

The latest receiver solution as the flight computer received it.

| Offset | Type | Field | Notes |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 0 | u8 | fixType | fix type (`fsw::GnssFixType`): 0 None, 1 Standalone, 2 RtkFixed |
| 1 | u8 | satellitesUsed | satellites in the solution |
| 2 | u8 | satellitesVisible | satellites visible |
| 3 | u8[1] | pad | 0 |
| 4 | f64 | fixTime | [s] time of validity, flight computer time |
| 12 | f64 | latitude | [rad] WGS-84 geodetic, antenna |
| 20 | f64 | longitude | [rad] east positive |
| 28 | f64 | height | [m] ellipsoidal |
| 36 | f32[3] | velocity | [m/s] east, north, up at the antenna |
| 48 | f32 | horizontalSigma | [m] receiver-reported 1 sigma |
| 52 | f32 | verticalSigma | [m] receiver-reported 1 sigma |


## Vehicle constants the console needs

Not downlinked (they are configuration): engine i sits at azimuth `engineAzimuthFirstDeg + engineAzimuthStepDeg * i` from body +x toward +y.

| Constant | Value | Unit | Meaning | Source |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `engineCount` | 3 |  | Engines in the hop configuration (three sea-level Raptor 3). | sim_vehicle/include/sim/vehicle/HopperParams.hpp (estimate) |
| `engineAzimuthFirstDeg` | 90 | deg | Azimuth of engine 0 from body +x toward +y; engine i sits at this plus engineAzimuthStepDeg * i. | sim_vehicle/include/sim/vehicle/HopperParams.hpp (estimate) |
| `engineAzimuthStepDeg` | 120 | deg | Azimuth step between engines. | sim_vehicle/include/sim/vehicle/HopperParams.hpp (estimate) |
| `engineRadius` | 1.55 | m | Engine distance from the vehicle axis. | sim_vehicle/include/sim/vehicle/HopperParams.hpp (estimate) |
| `gimbalLimitDeg` | 15 | deg | Gimbal deflection limit. | sim_vehicle/include/sim/vehicle/HopperParams.hpp (estimate) |
